title: Signed tensor-shift squares before Roos realization
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite coefficient extension E, an isomorphism g:X→Y with l invertible, normalized completion data D and tensor reindexing T satisfying their Laws [def-pod-completion-reindex-models, def-pod-completion-tensor-normalization]. Let SY and SX be signed tensor shifts satisfying their Generators laws [def-pod-completion-reindex-shifts]. For every pair of flat-term K-flat complexes P,Q on Y and integer r, the two strict tower maps from the reindexed finite total tensor of (P[r],Q) to the shift of the finite total tensor of (g*P,g*Q) agree: first shift on Y and reindex, or first reindex, apply the termwise reindexing/shift comparison to the first input and then shift on X. The analogous two tower maps for (P,Q[r]) also agree, with the right-slot Koszul sign. These are equalities of natural transformations of complete strict quotient towers, before Roos or localization [def-pod-completion-tensor-reindex-models].

proof.text: Evaluate at a quotient and a total degree. Reindexing is sectionwise relabelling. Use tensor and coproduct extensionality to test the two maps on homogeneous pure tensors. The sheafified-tensor and restricted-scalar generator extensionality is the same one used in the strict tensor construction of integralOperationsWellDefined.

Apply T.Generators, SY.Generators and SX.Generators. The first slot gives the same relabelled tensor. The second gives the same tensor multiplied by (-1)^(pr). D.QuotientGenerators identifies the shifted quotient map with the quotient map in degree p+r (or q+r): verify this first on a scalar-tensor generator and use scalar-extension generator extensionality. Thus the two component maps agree. Complex and natural-transformation extensionality prove the entire tower equalities.

proof_origin.place: Steps 1 and 5; tensor-factor signed-shift squares. Explicit expansion of the indicated model calculation.

theorem podTensorShift_strictTowerSquares
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (D : PodCompletionReindex l E g) (hD : PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E g D)
    (T : PodCompletedTensorReindex l E g D) (hT : PodCompletedTensorReindex.Laws l E g D T)
    (SY : PodTensorSignedShift l E Y) (SX : PodTensorSignedShift l E X)
    (hSY : SY.Generators l E) (hSX : SX.Generators l E)
    (P Q : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory) (r : ℤ) :
    letI : (isoReductionIntegralInverse l E g).Additive :=
      isoSectionwiseModuleInverseImage_additive.{u, u} g (isoReductionCompletedMap l E g).hom
    letI : PreservesFiniteLimits (isoReductionIntegralInverse l E g) :=
      isoSectionwiseModuleInverseImage_limits.{u, u} g (isoReductionCompletedMap l E g).hom
    letI : PreservesFiniteColimits (isoReductionIntegralInverse l E g) :=
      isoSectionwiseModuleInverseImage_colimits.{u, u} g (isoReductionCompletedMap l E g).hom
    let PX := (podGoodReindex l E g D).obj P
    let QX := (podGoodReindex l E g D).obj Q
    let TY := integralOperationsTensorTowerFunctor l E Y
    let TX := integralOperationsTensorTowerFunctor l E X
    let PYr := (⟨P.obj⟦r⟧, SY.good P r⟩ :
      (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory)
    let QYr := (⟨Q.obj⟦r⟧, SY.good Q r⟩ :
      (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory)
    let L₁ := (podReindexTower l E g).map (SY.leftTower P Q r).hom ≫
      (podTowerShift l E g (TY.obj (P.obj, Q.obj)) r).hom ≫
      whiskerRight (T.tower P Q).hom (shiftFunctor _ r)
    let L₂ := (T.tower PYr Q).hom ≫
      TX.map (Prod.mkHom (((isoReductionIntegralComplex l E g).commShiftIso r).hom.app P.obj)
        (𝟙 QX.obj)) ≫ (SX.leftTower PX QX r).hom
    let R₁ := (podReindexTower l E g).map (SY.rightTower P Q r).hom ≫
      (podTowerShift l E g (TY.obj (P.obj, Q.obj)) r).hom ≫
      whiskerRight (T.tower P Q).hom (shiftFunctor _ r)
    let R₂ := (T.tower P QYr).hom ≫
      TX.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 PX.obj)
        (((isoReductionIntegralComplex l E g).commShiftIso r).hom.app Q.obj)) ≫
      (SX.rightTower PX QX r).hom
    L₁ = L₂ ∧ R₁ = R₂
